<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center; background-color: white"><B>PART I</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;1. Exchange Act Reporting
History </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">A.
PetroChina Company Limited (the &ldquo;<U>Company</U>&rdquo;) first became subject to reporting obligations under Section&nbsp;13(a) or
Section&nbsp;15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &ldquo;<U>Exchange Act</U>&rdquo;), in April 2000, following
the listing of the Company&rsquo;s American depositary shares (&ldquo;<U>ADSs</U>&rdquo;), representing its Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares,
on the New York Stock Exchange (the &ldquo;<U>NYSE</U>&rdquo;). On August 29, 2022, the Company voluntarily filed a Form 25 with the Securities
and Exchange Commission (the &ldquo;<U>Commission</U>&rdquo;) informing the Commission that the Company had determined to voluntarily
delist the ADSs from the NYSE.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">B.
The Company has filed or submitted all reports required under Section&nbsp;13(a) or Section&nbsp;15(d) of the Exchange Act and corresponding
Commission rules for the&nbsp;12-months&nbsp;preceding the filing of this Form 15F. The Company has filed at least one annual report under
Section&nbsp;13(a) of the Exchange Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.25in 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;2. Recent United States
Market Activity</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">The
Company&rsquo;s ADSs were last sold in the United States in a registered offering under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &ldquo;<U>Securities
Act</U>&rdquo;) in April 2000 pursuant to a registration statement on Form&nbsp;F-1 (Registration No. 333-11566) and Form&nbsp;F-6 (Registration
No.333-11570),&nbsp;as amended.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.25in 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;3. Foreign Listing and Primary
Trading Market </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">A.
The foreign exchange on which the Company has maintained a listing of its Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares is The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong
Limited (the &ldquo;<U>SEHK</U>&rdquo;) and such exchange constitutes the primary trading market for the Company&rsquo; Class&nbsp;H Ordinary
Shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">B.
The Company was initially listed on SEHK in April 2000. The Company has maintained the listing of its Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares on
SEHK for at least the&nbsp;12-months&nbsp;preceding the filing of this Form 15F.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center">&nbsp;<!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->2<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">C.
The percentage of trading in Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares that occurred in Hong Kong for the&nbsp;12-month&nbsp;period from January 31,
2023 to January 30, 2024 (both dates inclusive) was 99.8%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.25in 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;4. Comparative Trading Volume
Data</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">A.
The&nbsp;12-month&nbsp;period used for calculations under Rule&nbsp;12h-6(a)(4)(i)&nbsp;was from January 31, 2023 to January 30, 2024
(both dates inclusive).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">B.
The average daily trading volume of the Company&rsquo;s Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares in the United States was 211,637 shares for the same&nbsp;12-month&nbsp;period.
The average daily trading volume of the Company&rsquo;s Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares worldwide was 117,628,748 shares for the same&nbsp;12-month&nbsp;period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">C.
The average daily trading volume of the Company&rsquo;s Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares in the United States as a percentage of the
average daily trading volume of the Company&rsquo;s Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares on a worldwide basis for the
same&nbsp;12-month&nbsp;period was approximately 0.2%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">D.
The Company delisted its ADSs from the NYSE effective as of the end of the trading day on September 8, 2022. As of September 8, 2022,
the average daily trading volume of the Company&rsquo;s Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares in the United States as a percentage of the average
daily trading volume for the Company&rsquo;s Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares on a worldwide basis for the preceding&nbsp;12-month&nbsp;period
was approximately 15.3%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">E.
The Company has terminated its sponsored American Depositary Receipt facility regarding its Class&nbsp;H Ordinary Shares as of the end
of the trading day of October&nbsp;19, 2022. The Bank of New York Mellon served as the depositary for the facility. As of October 19,
2022, the average daily trading volume of the Company&rsquo;s Class H Ordinary Shares in the United States as a percentage of the average
daily trading volume for the Company&rsquo;s Class H Ordinary Shares on a worldwide basis for the preceding 12-month period was approximately
15.2%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">F.
The Company used Bloomberg L.P. as the source for determining whether it meets the average daily trading volume requirements of Rule&nbsp;12h-6.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.25in 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;5. Alternative Record Holder
Information</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 6pt 0 0; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">Not applicable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.25in 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;6. Debt Securities</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 6pt 0 0; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">Not applicable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.25in 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;7. Notice Requirement</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">The
Company published a notice of its intent to terminate its duty to file reports under Section&nbsp;13(a) and Section&nbsp;15(d) of the
Exchange Act on February 5, 2024 and used ACCESSWIRE to disseminate the notice, including in the United States. A copy of the notice
was posted to the Company&rsquo;s website and another copy of the notice was furnished to the Commission under the cover of Form&nbsp;6-K&nbsp;via
EDGAR on February 5, 2024.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.25in 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;8. Prior Form 15 Filers</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 6pt 0 0; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">Not applicable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 6pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: center; background-color: white"><B>PART II</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;9. Rule&nbsp;12g3-2(b)&nbsp;Exemption</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">The
Company will publish the information required under Rule&nbsp;12g3-2(b)(1)(iii)&nbsp;on its website, <FONT STYLE="color: Blue"><U>https://www.petrochina.com.cn/</U> </FONT>and
the website of SEHK.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 6pt 0 0; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 24pt 0 0; text-align: center; background-color: white"><B>PART III</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;10. Exhibits </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 6pt 0 0; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">None.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.25in 0 0; background-color: white"><B>Item&nbsp;11. Undertakings</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">The
undersigned issuer hereby undertakes to withdraw this Form 15F if, at any time before the effectiveness of its termination of reporting
under Rule&nbsp;12h-6,&nbsp;it has actual knowledge of information that causes it reasonably to believe that, at the time of filing the
Form 15F:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">(1)
The average daily trading volume of its subject class of securities in the United States exceeded 5&nbsp;percent of the average daily
trading volume of that class of securities on a worldwide basis for the same recent&nbsp;12-month&nbsp;period that the issuer used for
purposes of Rule&nbsp;12h-6(a)(4)(i);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">(2)
Its subject class of securities was held of record by 300 or more United States residents or 300 or more persons worldwide, if proceeding
under Rule&nbsp;12h-6(a)(4)(ii)&nbsp;or Rule&nbsp;12h-6(c);&nbsp;or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">(3)
It otherwise did not qualify for termination of its Exchange Act reporting obligations under Rule&nbsp;12h-6.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 6pt 0 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 24.5pt; background-color: white">&nbsp;</P>
